thought.text: The build needs a JDK. Let me check available JDKs and install one to bootstrap the build (Gradle toolchains will download JDK 25 via foojay):

reasoning_content:
I need to set up JDK 25 for the Gradle build, so I'm considering options like temurin or installing OpenJDK 21 from Ubuntu's repositories, though I'm not certain if 21 is available on the system.

Let me reconsider whether I actually need to run this locally. The Gradle daemon can automatically download and use the JDK 25 toolchain via foojay if network access is available, so I just need a baseline JDK 17 or higher to bootstrap the Gradle wrapper itself. Gradle 9.x requires at least JDK 17 to run, so I could install OpenJDK 17 or 21 from apt as the bootstrap, and let Gradle handle downloading the actual JDK 25 toolchain it needs for compilation.
